business_problem: Ordos needed a repeatable way to modernize hundreds of fragmented coal mines, but operators lacked shared standards, interoperable data, scalable AI infrastructure, and reusable models for safety, efficiency, and low-labor mining operations.
solution_summary: Ordos City built a regional coal-industry internet platform on Huawei Cloud Stack using a hybrid "industry center cloud + mine edge cloud" architecture. The center platform standardizes industrial data collection, data fusion, AI services, and industry sharing for 96 mining work scenarios across tunneling, coal cutting, and main haulage, while three standardized edge-access patterns connect individual mine enterprises to the shared platform. Huawei's AI infrastructure and the Pangu mining large model provide visual and predictive capabilities, and a MaaS application marketplace links local solutions with the Huawei Cloud marketplace so mines can reuse AI products instead of building siloed systems. The operating loop follows "center training, edge inference, cloud-edge collaboration, learning while using, and continuous optimization," allowing pre-trained models to be adapted with small volumes of site data and rolled out across regional mines as a standardized smart-mining service.

data_flow: Mine operational data is collected and fused in the center-cloud platform, where models are trained and managed, then pushed to edge clouds at participating mines for local inference. Outputs and reusable apps flow back through the shared marketplace and regional industrial internet platform for rapid rollout to new sites.
business_outcome: Ordos turned smart-mining AI into a reusable regional platform that improved recognition accuracy, cut model-adaptation effort, and created a standardized rollout path across demonstration mines and future enterprise participants.

"The platform combines industrial data collection, data fusion, AI, and industry sharing, plus three standardized edge-access schemes that connect mines to the center platform for rapid replication. (original: 采用中心平台工业数采+数据融合+人工智能+行业共享方案，以及三套边缘矿企标准接入方案，打通矿企与中心平台，实现区域矿端的标准化快速复制。)"

"Using the Pangu mining large model, Ordos adopted a "center training, edge inference, cloud-edge collaboration, learning while using, continuous optimization" mechanism, lifting average recognition accuracy by more than 20%. (original: 依托盘古矿山大模型，构建"中心训练、边缘推理、云边协同、边用边学、持续优化"训练机制，平均识别精度提升20%以上。)"

"The platform has already launched 5 demonstration mines covering more than 40 AI scenarios and aims to serve more than 260 enterprises within 3 years while saving more than 90% of labeling work. (original: 落地5家示范矿，覆盖40+AI场景，未来3年将实现服务超过260家企业。... 节省超过90%的数据样本标注工作量。)"
